agency_name: NC Department of Health and Human Services
mission: In collaboration with our partners, DHHS provides essential services to improve the health, safety, and well-being of all North Carolinians.

goals.title: Access to care
goals.description: Expand access to healthcare by ensuring all individuals no matter their location have a nearby health service and that said health service is affordable. Limit existing social or logistical barriers to accessing healthcare via policy and other programs of mitigation.

goals.title: Whole person well-being
goals.description: Ensure that healthcare services are high-quality and attend to all of a person's medical needs. To be achieved by improving coordination between systems, improving both the quality of care but also the reach of care. Select medical needs of interest are access to healthy food and access to mental health, brain injury, and/or disability care.

goals.title: Transform and modernize health care
goals.description: Modernize programs to improve access and lower operating costs using the resources of the state to track costs and use its influence to secure resources and knowledge, including a sustainable rural health delivery system and the expertise of state-operated health care facilities.

goals.title: Sustainable workforce
goals.description: Develop and improve the medical workforce both by making career pathways more accessible through removal of employment barriers and developing new recruitment strategies. Then train the workforce so that they are more coordinated and can perform higher quality care.

goals.title: Organizational excellence
goals.description: Foster a culture that champions collaboration, data-driven decision making, accountability, risk management, and efficient use of resources.
